hints.title: Row Similarity or Inverse Equivalence
hints.text: Two rows can become identical after some column flips if and only if they are initially identical or exact bitwise inverses of each other across every column.

hints.title: Canonical Pattern Mapping
hints.text: Normalize each row into a canonical signature: if the first value is 0, preserve the row; if the first value is 1, invert all values in the row.

hints.title: Frequency Maximum
hints.text: Record the frequency of each canonical row pattern. The maximum frequency across all pattern buckets gives the maximum number of equal rows achievable.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 2^N possible column flip combinations takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping rows by normalized canonical patterns takes linear O(M * N) time and storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that rows can align iff they match or are inverted, and normalize rows.
complexity.notes: Canonical signature takes O(N) string or tuple representation per row.
